'''Main Boulevard''' was the central road of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It lead from the [[Palace Plaza/Legends|Palace Plaza]] to the intricate ceremonial gates of Theed. It ended in '''Main Boulevard Bridge''', which crossed one of the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River's]] tributaries.

==History==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], the Main Boulevard and its bridge served as the primary causeway for a column of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] invading [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]].
